title.en: MALACAÑANG BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES CREATING A COMMITTEE FOR THE SPECIAL PROTECTION OF CHILDREN FROM ALL FORMS OF NEGLECT, ABUSE, CRUELTY, EXPLOITATION, DISCRIMINATION AND OTHER CONDITIONS PREJUDICIAL TO THEIR DEVELOPMENT

text.en:
There is hereby created a Special Committee for Children to be
composed of:
1. The Secretary of Justice
2. The Secretary of Social Welfare and
Development
Co-Chairman
3. The Chairman of the Commission on
Human Rights
4. Commissioner of the Bureau of Immigration
A representative with a rank not lower than undersecretary from the following:
5. Department of Labor and Employment
DEPLYING, PLEASE CITE:
1951298

6. Department of Tourism
7. Department of the Interior and Local
Government
8. Department of Foreign Affairs
9. Three representatives of private
organizations to be nominated
by said groups and appointed by the

The Committee shall exercise the following functions and duties:
To report to the President actions taken to address specific issues on
child abuse and exploitation brought to the Committee's attention.
To direct other agencies to immediately respond to the problems brought
to their attention and to report to the Committee on action taken.
To perform such other functions and duties as may be necessary to meet
the objectives of the Committee.

The Council for the Welfare of Children shall act as the Secretariat of
the Committee.

The initial amount of P10,000,000.00 is hereby authorized to be
released from the Presidential Social Fund.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 14thday of September
Lord, Nineteen Hundred and Ninety-Five.
, in the year of Our
By the President:
(RUBEN D. TORRES
Executive Secretary
